canonical_project: Haidai Zhisuan Delingha Intelligent Computing Center
owner: Qinghai Intelligent Computing Technology Co. (Haidai Zhisuan)
notes: Regional press reports the Delingha intelligent computing center project in Haixi Prefecture's green industrial park topped out main structure in September 2025; ~RMB1.2bn investment, ~41 mu site; phase II No.3 data center construction tender announced March 2026 with ~RMB1.5bn budget.
